info.title: FAR-Lab API
info.description: FAR-Lab 对外 HTTP API（24§5）。V2 receipts 端点采用统一信封 { ok: true, data: T } + RFC 7807 错误响应（R-05）。

200.description: Current process and FAR-Lab database gauges

500.description: Metrics collection failed; plain-text diagnostic without fabricated samples

401.description: Authentication is required in protected mode

400.description: Sequence is not a canonical positive safe integer

401.description: Authentication is required in protected mode

404.description: No call record exists at the requested sequence

401.description: Authentication is required in protected mode

get.description: Returns the demo sample receipt with six-dimension verification ({ ok: true, data: { receipt, verification } }).

post.description: Verify a submitted ProofEnvelopeV2. Returns unified envelope { ok: true, data: { verification, display } }. Validation errors return RFC 7807 { error_code, message, source_anchor, detail? }.

Create a persisted receipt. Idempotent: same proofHash returns existing receiptId with 200 + idempotent=true. New receipt returns 201 + idempotent=false. Response: { ok: true, data: { receiptId, idempotent } }.

get.summary: List receipts (limit/offset pagination, optional claimId filter)
get.description: List persisted receipts with limit/offset pagination. Response: { ok: true, data: { receipts, total, limit, offset } }. limit: 1..100 (default 20), offset: >=0 (default 0), claimId: optional exact-match filter (runId of a wizard run).

get.summary: Get receipt detail (manifest members + latest verification)
get.description: Get a single receipt with manifest members and latest persisted verification. Response: { ok: true, data: { receipt, manifestMembers, latestVerification } }. 404 if not found (RFC 7807).

get.summary: Re-verify a receipt (run + persist six-dimension result)
get.description: Run V2 six-dimension verification on a persisted receipt, persist the result, return it. Response: { ok: true, data: { verification, display, allPass } }. 404 if not found (RFC 7807).
